description: This file defines a class 'XRadialGradientBrush' for representing a radial gradient brush with support for different .NET UI frameworks (GDI, WPF, UWP). It provides constructors, properties, and methods to manage the transformation matrix, inner and outer radii, and realization of platform-specific gradient brush objects.

classes.name: XRadialGradientBrush
classes.description: A class representing a radial gradient brush with support for transformation, inner and outer radii, customizable colors, and platform-specific brush realization.

methods.name: XRadialGradientBrush
methods.description: Constructs an XRadialGradientBrush given points, radii, and colors, with multiple constructor overloads for different platform types.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Property to get or set the transformation matrix applied to the brush.

methods.name: InnerRadius
methods.description: Property to get or set the inner radius of the radial gradient.

methods.name: OuterRadius
methods.description: Property to get or set the outer radius of the radial gradient.

methods.name: TranslateTransform
methods.description: Method to translate the brush's transformation by a given offset.

methods.name: ScaleTransform
methods.description: Method to scale the brush's transformation.

methods.name: RotateTransform
methods.description: Method to rotate the brush's transformation.

methods.name: MultiplyTransform
methods.description: Method to multiply the brush's transformation matrix.

methods.name: ResetTransform
methods.description: Method to reset the transformation matrix to identity.
